categories.heading: Rule changes
categories.description: The mechanics changed: numbers, costs, must/may, what a roll does. Replacing an old value or behaviour; writing down a value already in effect is wording.

categories.heading: Wording
categories.description: The prose changed, the meaning didn't. Includes correcting a worked example.

categories.heading: Organization
categories.description: Pages or sections moved, nested, reordered or renamed; numbering steps.

categories.heading: Visual
categories.description: Markup or layout changed, the text didn't. Restyling prose into or out of a callout.

categories.heading: Tooling
categories.description: The change touched no content file.

release.beforeCommit: if [ -f ../../scripts/gen-theme.mjs ]; then node ../../scripts/gen-theme.mjs; else echo 'warning: app checkout not found; Obsidian snippet not regenerated'; fi
